name: Franklin Precision Industry
old_description: Franklin Precision Industry was established in April of 1989 in the community of Franklin, Kentucky. Franklin Precision Industry Inc. (FPI) is a leading manufacturer of automotive fuel and engine system components. FPI derived its name in honor of the Franklin community and to acknowledge the fact that the company manufactures high quality, precision automotive components for distribution in North America and Asia.
about:
Franklin Precision Industry was established in April 1989 in Franklin, Kentucky. The company took its name from the local community to reflect its focus on manufacturing high‑quality, precision automotive components for distribution across North America and Asia.

The company specializes in fluid control components for automotive fuel and engine systems, producing throttle bodies, EGR valves, fuel pump modules, charcoal canisters, and EV busbars. Production relies on CNC form measurement machines and automated CNC inspection systems that perform repetitive quality checks to reduce human error. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

FPI serves the automotive sector, with a noted customer relationship with Aisan Industry Co., Ltd. Its components are supplied to vehicle manufacturers and tier‑one suppliers in both North American and Asian markets.

The business was founded to bring precision‑crafted fluid control parts to the automotive supply chain, emphasizing reliable supply and unmatched quality through certified quality management systems and innovative manufacturing technology.
